title: WatchFace (APPS Large) not right rendered after upgrade from AAPS 3.2.0.4 to AAPS 3.3.0
symptom: After upgrade from AAPS 3.2.0.4 to 3.3.0, the Custom WatchFace AAPS(Large) is not properly rendered. The white row ("MatchDivider") in the middle of the screen is not visible, and also the value inside the MatchDivider.
cause: The issue is due to a fresh install of Wear apk, then the default values shown within watch for each parameter, and the value read within CWF can be inconsistent.
fix: Workaround: switch on then switch off each parameter of AAPS(Large) to get correct visibility of watchface. For the background and white bar: Set Dark parameter enabled, then disabled (or opposite); Set matchdivider to enabled, then disable (or opposite). In case of overlapping, manually change the value of "min ago", "Uploader Battery" and "Status information".
settings_changed: Dark parameter → enabled then disabled (or opposite)
